scope: Go consumer/render/cache semantic slice only; no App or resource rebuild, no GUI/Host mutation, no composer_native import.

schema.baseline: schema1 + baselineSerial monotonic per helper + epoch token + initial revision0
schema.transaction: chatPresentationPatch base/next revision, turn/step upserts/removes, payload upserts/removes/suffixes and raw timelineTurnUpserts admitted before any mutation; one scoped UI update
schema.causality: stale serial/epoch/revision ignored, invalid/gap preserves valid state with explicit reopen error; no automatic session reopen or mutation replay
schema.scalars: sessionState/pending/sessionProjections/trajectory also version guarded in metadata sessions; legacy without presentation remains compatible

rules: Latest chronological step/final qualification comes from helper authority; unknown/image are replies, later empty/tool step never promotes older text. Retired/unreferenced assistant bodies stay in arena but never fall back to printable text UI.
Reasoning/response reference one existing body by stable nodeKey+part; suffix changes visible through the same cache. UI node key never replaces durable Seq/SourceMessageID.

Only assistant layout references use fractional anchors; raw nonassistant source order/unpositioned barriers are retained. Successful retained anchor2.5 crosses input3 until step/end restores durable4, with unchanged UI key and no duplicate.

Exactly one independent turn controller, including pure final; open turns have no closed control; always-open/interleaved/partial insufficient states cannot collapse. Loaded end without start may fold when source authority permits.
Explicit disclosure choice is scoped by account/Host/session+turn+answerStep; all reply parts share it, and later default timing changes do not overwrite a saved choice for that answer.

Nonblank reasoning matches ECMAScript trim; terminal marker deliberately uses the original raw block-kind predicate. Original BOM/blank text quirk retained (reasoning-only marker can be0); NEL response has1.
Process bodies are individual virtual List part rows; preserved bounded image cache and paint-only spinner scheduling.

tests.independent: Root seven pinned assembler -> actual view cases plus corrected Unicode overlay passed before final checkpoint; final independent Go reviewer pending.
